# URL slug generator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/slug-generator/

Turn a title into a lowercase URL slug with consistent separators. Choose whether to keep Unicode letters or use an ASCII-only approximation.

## How to use it

1. Enter a sample value, color, URL or structured input.
2. Choose the required format or options and run the tool.
3. Review the output and copy it into your own workflow.

## Example

Convert My New Tool: A Quick Guide into my-new-tool-a-quick-guide.

## Limits and checks

A slug is only one part of a URL. Check that your destination site accepts the chosen characters and that the slug is unique there.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
